Top Investors Hold Stakes Worth Over Rs 26,500 Cr in NSE IPO

Several prominent investors, including RK Damani, Premji, Sunil Munjal, Raamdeo Agrawal, Dolly Khanna, and Kris Gopalakrishnan, hold stakes valued at over Rs 26,500 crore in the National Stock Exchange (NSE) ahead of its Initial Public Offering (IPO). Reports indicate that none of these major investors are currently looking to sell their holdings.
